comment: Files the tests read that are not committed: scripts/test-libraries.ps1 downloads each (SHA-256 checked) into .native-build/test-downloads and copies it to tests/<file> (git-ignored). The MediaPipe person detection and pose landmark models in ONNX form from OpenCV Zoo, Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/opencv/opencv_zoo/blob/main/LICENSE; weights from Google MediaPipe).
